notes.title: Bad Faith is ONE YEAR OLD!
notes.content:
https://pbs.twimg.com/media/FltF9g7WQAMQG_f?format=jpg&name=medium

Can you believe it?! 

Bad Faith is now one year old!


Time's really flown by... I'm really happy you've all enjoyed playing my visual novel as much as I've enjoyed making it.

To celebrate - I've prepped three Bad Faith related goodies for you...


First - Bad Faith's DEMO is now available in German!

With the help of Mimir Translations, I've worked behind the scenes to produce a new German localization for Bad Faith's DEMO. If this translation is well-received, the whole game will be localized. 

This update also has several QOL updates for the DEMO that were present in the final game; such as the preview textbox in the Preferences menu and the tooltip text for the in-game quick menu.

You can download the new version of Bad Faith's DEMO now!

Second - I've written a postmortem for Bad Faith!

Click the link above to read my postmortem. 

Here, you'll see my thoughts on the game one year on; from what I enjoyed to what I thought I could've improved on. Additionally, I'll discuss Bad Faith's future, and other stories I want to tell...

Third - I've uploaded .psds of Bad Faith's character sprites!

Click the link above to access the files.

If you've ever wondered how I've made my character sprites for the game, now's your chance to study them! 

Feel free to play around with them too; I'd love to see what memes you make...

Additionally, between January 9th-January 16th, Bad Faith will be 25% off.

If you've wanted to get a copy of Bad Faith for yourself, mark your calendars for these dates!

I'll be very vocal about this once the sale rolls around, but I wanted to give you all a week-long heads-up to get prepared.

Thank you all for the incredible amount of support for Bad Faith. 

I hope you enjoy these goodies, and I'll see you in the future!

-Mado
